name: ALYANNA

description.short: Strapless A-line gown with premium laser-cut rose lace and bold floral texture.
description.full:
Pricing & Availability

  • Made to Order: ₱20,000
  • Custom size available

Details

  • Style: Strapless A-Line Gown
  • Fabric: Premium Laser-Cut Rose Lace
  • Color: White
  • Design: Bold floral texture with a classic silhouette

Features

  • Rose Lace Overlay: Features a unique, all-over rose pattern for a romantic look.
  • Strapless Straight Neckline: A clean, elegant top that highlights the shoulders.
  • Structured Bodice: Provides a secure fit that flows seamlessly into the skirt.
  • Classic A-Line Skirt: A graceful, flared skirt that offers effortless movement.
  • Scalloped Hemline: Finished with beautiful rose-cut lace edges along the trail.
  • Customizable Trail: Trail length can be modified for Made to Order (MTO) requests.
  • Adjustable Back: Ensures a perfect and comfortable fit.

Add-on

  • Matching Veil: Available as an add-on; price varies depending on length and design.

priceMessage: Message us on Facebook for inquiries on custom measurements or to start your order!
